entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 44684 of 2022
Applicant :- Sandeep Kumar

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhanshu Kumar Singh,Shailendra Pratap Subodh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.  The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed by the applicant on the false pretext of marriage and physical relation was formed.
It was also alleged that the daughter of the informant is carrying a fetus of four months.
3. The Counsel for the applicant argues that the allegations in the FIR are prima facie incorrect and it was a case of consensual relation.
The age of the victim is approximately 17 years, however, there is no determination of age of the victim so far.

The applicant is in custody since 24.06.2019 and Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86641169/
1 although the trial is going on and the same is not likely to be concluded in near future.

entities.text: Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the allegations levelled in the FIR and the submissions advanced by the Counsel for the applicant; prima facie, there is no material to determined the age of the victim which is the subject matter of the evidence i.e. led at the time of trial; the FIR does not contained any statement as to when at the first time, the misstatement or misrepresentation with regard to the promise of marriage was given to the victim, as such, prima facie material to determined the misconception of fact accrued in the mind of the victim is unascertained; the applicant is in custody since 24.06.2019 and has no criminal antecedents and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Sandeep Kumar be released on bail in S.S.T. No.55 of 2019 arising out of Case Crime No.205 of 2019, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, Police Station Sarai Lskhansi, District Mau on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.8.2023 akverma  Sandeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86641169/
